integrity: The theorem follows from the cited classification plus a bounded-variation Riemann sum and an absolutely convergent zeta expansion; 4116 independent finite semigroup enumerations are corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-genus reflective class only. The source classification, individual semigroup invariants, and reflective Wilf inequality are prior work. The reported law is asymptotic; it does not provide a finite-genus joint histogram or establish the general Wilf conjecture. Earlier unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: A zeta-moment limit law for Wilf surplus in reflective numerical semigroups
